def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_color = 2
    sep = next((r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep_color for v in grid[r])), None)
    axis = "h"
    if sep is None:
        sep = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep_color for r in range(h))), None)
        axis = "v"
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, sep_color)]
    if not pts or sep is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if axis == "h":
        dr = sep+1-r0 if r0>sep else sep-1-r1
        far = r1+dr+1 if r0>sep else r0+dr-1
        box=[grid[r][c0:c1+1] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1): out[r][c]=bg
        for i,row in enumerate(box): out[r0+dr+i][c0:c1+1]=row
        if 0<=far<h: out[far]=[8]*w
    else:
        dc = sep+1-c0 if c0>sep else sep-1-c1
        far = c1+dc+1 if c0>sep else c0+dc-1
        box=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1): out[r][c]=bg
        for i in range(r0,r1+1):
            for j in range(c0,c1+1): out[i][j+dc]=grid[i][j]
        if 0<=far<w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][far]=8
    return out
